responsibility: Computes, stores, updates, and streams function and call summaries used chiefly by inlining and specialization heuristics. It analyzes GIMPLE bodies to estimate size, time, stack usage, predicates, loop-related hints, builtin_constant_p sensitivity, and per-call costs; maintains summary objects across cloning and inlining; and provides passes for local summary generation, IPA summary streaming, and later summary release. This file is the implementation of the summary model consumed by ipa-inline, ipa-cp, and related IPA passes.
same_name_distinction: Contains the implementation and pass machinery for building, updating, streaming, and freeing function and call summaries, including local-fnsummary and IPA summary passes. Unlike gcc/ipa-fnsummary.h, it is not just the summary schema/API; it performs the actual analysis and lifecycle management.
